gate: docs/PROJ_PATH_SHAPE_GATE.md section 0a (GATE 0.1), produced under amendment A-2 23.2 (f) after the fWAR epoch's step Z entry
read: OWNER-WAIVED EARLY READ (owner EW3-5, 2026-10-14): the registered 2026-09-25 date was missed under A-2 and the artifact is produced now, on the served payload of this day
pool: veteran rows carrying surNpv and a salary path with a five-season `war` (registered at 895 on 2026-09-18; recounted here)

repricer.method: served legacy pricing per row: proj_export._season_value_usd on the served salPath dollars, salary_path.club_option_floor, salary_path.apply_cliff (mode full), rate 0.070; contract tail chained by fa_market.chain_aging_tail on warChamp + warChampTail
repricer.default_ros_held: the rest-of-season leg (surTotal - surNpv) is held at its served value under every reshape
repricer.identity_reproduction_reads: the served warTail for the seasons past 2031; every reshape (IDENTITY included) re-chains its tail from its own 2031 value, which is the seam a refit would move
repricer.moves_are: reshape minus IDENTITY, both on this repricer with the tail re-chained

reshapes.maxsmooth: warChamp rescaled to the served 5-year `war` total
reshapes.ramp: straight line with slope (war[4]-war[0])/4, shifted so the 5-year total is preserved (both endpoints cannot be kept and the total preserved at once; the slope and total are kept)

reordering_criterion: NOT demoted: an extreme reshape reorders surTotal below Spearman 0.9990, so the order is recorded beside any flip (9.1 records it, gates nothing)
reading: This is a SHAPE-ONLY bound and says nothing about the level. A refit moves the level too; the level move is bounded by S3 (4.8) and by the dollar bands in section 9, not by this artifact.
Landing inside every band is not evidence that an arm worked.
